nom: Vichy Purete Thermale Fresh Cleansing Gel

avis.texte: I bought this thinking it was the same formula it is not. It dries out my skin plus strips away everything in a harsh way. Doesnt take off my basuc foundation well. Dont waste your money there are better face washes than this

avis.titre: Light, Foaming, but with a slight scent
avis.texte: I've been enjoying using this new face wash. I love the gel texture and it foams up nicely. It does have a slight scent to it. While it doesn't bother me, someone who is sensitive to scents might want to try a sample first.
I like how gentle this cleanser is, especially in the winter when my skin is very dry. I do think it gets my make up off just fine and the big bottle lasts me at least six months so I save money too.

I bought this cleanser because I have other Vichy products that I love and I figured I would give the cleanser a try. The first couple times I used it I liked it, but by the third day of using it it started to burn around my eyes and face. The burning sensation does not go away for a while, and after I get out of the shower my skin feels overly dry and tight. Perhaps this is better suited for oily skin but I was disappointed as it was marketed for sensitive skin.
Love this game changing cleanser. Struggling with rosacea prior to buying this cleanser. Skin cleared after one use.
The cleansing gel is too watery and feel that my skin is not as clean as the previous version/formula. Will discontinue using it.

I was in search of a good face cleanser and originally bought this cleanser on sale to try out. I was pleasantly surprised at how much I loved it. You need very little to get a good lather going. It rinses clean and doesn't leave my combination skin dry. I've tried other cleansers since finishing the bottle, but I am realizing how much more I love this one and miss using it.
